notes.subject: turn us / we return
notes.rationale: שׁוּב double sense: 'Turn us back to You' (God acts first) vs 'we will return' — the causative shape (hashivenu) means God must do the turning.

notes.subject: השיבנו / ונשוב
notes.rationale: Same root שׁוּב repeated: God's turning of us and our returning are one word, lost as two phrases in Tok Pisin.

translation: Kirapim yumi olsem i go bek long yu, Yahwe, na bai mipela i go bek; senisim olgeta ol de bilong mipela i kamap olsem long taim bipo.
